title: LMCache/LMCache Release v0.5.3rc3 · CUDA 12.9
event_hint: LMCache v0.5.3rc3 publishes a CUDA 12.9 wheel via a GitHub release
problem: The release addresses installation of LMCache v0.5.3rc3 in environments using CUDA 12.9 by publishing a compatible wheel and package-install instructions.
mechanism: The GitHub release provides a CUDA 12.9 build for LMCache v0.5.3rc3 and directs users to install it with uv pip, the PyTorch CUDA 12.9 extra index, the release's expanded-assets link, and unsafe-best-match index strategy.

evidence.claim: The release is titled v0.5.3rc3 and targets CUDA 12.9.
The release instructs users to install lmcache with uv pip using the PyTorch cu129 extra index and the release's expanded assets link.

evaluation_context: This is an upstream GitHub release page for LMCache. The available text documents packaging and installation only; it contains no benchmark, workload, hardware, latency, throughput, or cache-transfer measurements.
limitations: The release candidate label indicates pre-final software. The fetched page does not state API changes, compatibility beyond CUDA 12.9, runtime behavior, or performance effects; those require the package or release notes to be inspected separately.
project_relevance: A CUDA 12.9 wheel may unblock reproducing LMCache experiments on matching infrastructure, but this release alone provides no evidence of changes to KV-cache transfer performance or network scheduling.
source_notes: The specific upstream GitHub release URL was fetched and its release body was available despite page-loading warnings.
No performance or functional claims beyond the packaging instructions were inferred.
